root_idea.summary: The root centers on enveloping or covering and on close adherence or persistence.
root_idea.development: The concrete sense is a covering or blanket; this develops toward remaining closely attached or pressing persistently, yielding the Quranic sense of importunate asking.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested verbal noun is presented as its own normalized dictionary form.

senses.definition: Importunate persistence in asking; pressing a request insistently.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction of asking people with إِلْحَاف, it denotes persistent, importunate solicitation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A covering cloth or blanket; a night-wrapper or outer covering garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for a night-wrapper or covering garment, with classical usage recording variation over whether the cloth is lined or unlined.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Pointer-only unit directing the reader to the following entry.
Defines the covering garment and equates ملحفة with لحاف.
